requirements:
google-api-python-client
datadiff
prometheus-client
flask
jwcrypto
requests
simplejson
requests-mock
PyYAML
opentelemetry-api
json2html
dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
CMD ["python", "app.py"]
explanation: Generated requirements.txt with standard PyPI package names matching detected imports. Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim base, installs dependencies from requirements.txt, and assumes default entrypoint is app.py. Adjust CMD as needed for actual application entry point.
